menu.subtitle: Featuring nutritional and delicious vegetarian specialties prepared from tofu, tempeh, soymilk, and miso.

sections.name: BURGERS
notes: Served on a ww. sesame bun with sprouts, tomato, our special sauce, marinade, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Tofu Burger
items.description: a combination of fresh organic tofu, blended with sauteed carrots, mushrooms, onions, wheat germ, nutritional yeast, bread crumbs, and seasoning. A hit!

items.name: Tempeh Burger
items.description: an Indonesian soy patty with brown rice imparting a mushroom flavor and packed with 26 g. of protein. High energy, low in calories.

items.name: Soysage Burger
items.description: spicy, rich flavor reminiscent of sausage. High in fiber and protein, low in fat and calories.

items.name: Falafel Burger
items.description: garbanzos (chick peas) and a host of spices too lengthy to list. A zesty sandwich served with our sesame tahini dressing.

items.name: Tofulafel
items.description: we add our Israeli garbanzo mix to the tofu patty and East meets Zest! Served with our sesame tahini dressing.

items.name: TLT
items.description: open face sandwich with crispy strips of tempeh, lettuce, and tomato.

items.name: Shogun S.C.
items.description: a marinated slab of firm tofu, grilled and marinated again. Our quarter pounder!

sections.name: SANDWICHES
notes: Served on Grain Bin ww with sprouts, tomato, soy mayo, and a dill pickle.

items.name: Mock Chicken
items.description: savory baked tofu, chopped and layered. Delicious!

items.name: Avocado
items.description: what's an avocado doing in a place like this?

items.name: Tempeh
items.description: our tempeh salad made with mayo, celery, dill pickles and tempeh. A texture like potato salad.

sections.name: SALADS
notes: We make all of these salads daily from garden fresh produce.
1/2 pt. / pt. pricing shown where listed.
*try our Well Bean sampler—choice of any three salads for 2.95

items.name: Age Tofu Pouches
items.description: a traditional Japanese dish using deep fried firm style tofu as a pocket stuffed with our zingy Szechuan salad.

items.name: Tofu Steak
items.description: grilled tofu on a bed of lettuce, tomato, with chutney. Low calorie!

items.name: Tempeh Chips
items.description: crispy strips of soy-rice tempeh, salted and served with avocado guacamole and spicy salsa.

items.name: French Fried Yams
items.description: look out here come the yams!

sections.name: MILKSHAKES
notes: Made with local organic soymilk—bananas, and sweetened with honey and vanilla.
